title: analytic-model-catalog-entry.v0
description: A reusable INTERNAL analytic/ML model as a governed Crystal Atlas catalog entry. Distinct from model-catalog-entry.v0 (which catalogs LLM inference providers): this catalogs decisioning/predictive/analytic models (fraud, recommenders, churn, forecasting, ...). Every entry is a governed artifact — its output is an emitted-fact contract, and per the effect-canary discipline a model is only 'verified' when a named eval fixture passes (a card without a passing fixture is unverified, never silently trusted).

output_contract.description: The emitted-fact contract this model produces (existing for HAVE/PARTIAL; a proposed target name for GAP).

eval_fixture.description: Path/ref to the governed eval fixture that must pass for this model to be 'verified' (effect-canary).

verified.description: TRUE only when eval_fixture is set AND realizing_component is set. Enforced by the validator.

realizing_component.description: Service/app that realizes the model today (null for GAP).
